def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate the 8-bit value x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits around to the low end."""
    pre 0 <= k and k <= 7
    post out == ((x << k) | (x >> (8 - k))) & 255
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(200, 0) == 200
    wide: int = int(x)
    return uint8((wide * 2 ** k) % 256 + wide // 2 ** (8 - k)) % 256)
